title: Quinoa Casserole with Chicken

ingredients.raw: 3 Cups Cooked Chicken – skin discarded if applicable; chicken shredded or chopped
ingredients.prep: skin discarded if applicable; chicken shredded or chopped

ingredients.raw: ½ small Yellow Onion – finely diced
1 (4.5 ounce) Can Chopped Green Chiles – drained
¾ Cup Roasted Corn Kernels – canned or frozen (drained if using canned)
ingredients.prep: canned or frozen (drained if using canned)

ingredients.raw: ¾ Cup Black Beans – drained and rinsed
1 tsp EACH: Garlic Powder, Cumin, and Chili Powder
ingredients.item: garlic powder, cumin, and chili powder

ingredients.raw: 1 ½ Cups Colby Jack, Monterey Jack OR Pepper Jack Cheese – freshly shredded, divided
ingredients.item: colby jack, monterey jack or pepper jack cheese

ingredients.raw: 1 ¼ Cup Mozzarella Cheese – freshly shredded, divided
Optional Garnishes: Pico de Gallo Sliced Scallions, Chopped Cilantro, Sliced Avocados or Guacamole, Sour Cream
ingredients.item: pico de gallo, sliced scallions, chopped cilantro, sliced avocados or guacamole, sour cream

instructions: Preheat Oven and Prep Casserole Dish: Arrange oven rack to the center position and then preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 9×13'' baking dish (or similar-size casserole dish) with non-stick cooking spray and then set aside.

Cook the Quinoa: Follow the package instructions and cook the quinoa according to directions. Once cooked, remove the quinoa from the heat, fluff and season generously with salt and pepper. Then, transfer the cooked quinoa to a large bowl. (Tip: See the notes section below for how to perfectly cook quinoa!)

Mix Casserole Ingredients: Add the cooked chicken, salsa, onion, green chiles, corn, black beans, garlic powder, cumin and chili powder to the bowl of quinoa. Stir to combine. Fold in 1 cup of jack cheese and ½ cup of mozzarella. Generously season with salt and pepper. (SEE NOTES) Grab a spoon and try the casserole, then adjust the flavors to suit your tastebuds.
Transfer Quinoa Mixture to Prepared Casserole Dish: Carefully dump the casserole mixture into the prepared baking dish. Use a spoon or spatula to smooth down the top.

Top with Cheese and Bake: Sprinkle the remaining cheeses evenly over the top of the casserole. Then, transfer the quinoa casserole to the preheated oven and bake for 20-22 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

Serve Mexican Quinoa Casserole: Remove baking dish from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes. After cooling slightly, sprinkle your favorite Mexican garnishes, like pico, cilantro, and diced avocado over the top and dollop with sour cream, if using. Serve warm and enjoy immediately!
